{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm cleaning worked
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head(5))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"\nNumber of internal test orders: {len(internal_test)}")

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue from completed orders, excluding internal test orders
total_revenue_completed = completed[completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
print(f"\nTotal revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue_completed}")"}
